newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguan leader sets off for Taiwan visit.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguan leader sets off for Taiwan visit.

text.p: Nicaraguan leader Arnoldo Aleman set off on a five-day visit to Taiwan on Sunday and pledged the Central American nation would continue to recognise Taiwan despite the objections of China.

"We plan to manifest to President Lee (Teng-hui) our solidarity and unconditional support for the independence and sovereignty of the Republic of China (Taiwan)," Aleman told reporters before leaving.
Nicaragua and a handful of other countries recently proposed the U.N. General Assembly open discussions when it meets in September to grant Taiwan membership in the international body.
China, which regards Taiwan as a renegade province, responded angrily to Nicaragua's petition.
Aleman said he would be asking Taiwan for loans for a series of development projects in Nicaragua, one of the poorest countries in the western hemisphere.
